css.why: ONE rule block, after the r14 tickets-hub rule (BASE 568-570), collapsing the follower's padding-top between two adjacent same-tone .nos-section siblings. Tone is expressed by NosSection's tone class (components/nos/NosSection.tsx TONE_CLASSES: default '' / nos-section-gold / nos-section-royal nos-on-dark / nos-section-black nos-on-dark). VisitDisclosure paints a default-tone NosSection gold with className bg-[var(--gold)], so a bg- utility excludes a section from the default-ground match.
